title: Envelope
description: Every message exchanged between client and server is wrapped in this envelope.

type.description: Message type. Client to server: action. Server to client: action_accepted, action_rejected, event, snapshot, error.

request_id.description: Client-chosen ID that links an action to its responses and events.

seq.description: Server event sequence number, strictly increasing per session. Used to resume after reconnecting.

payload.description: Type-specific content, defined by the schema of each message type.
